lines.text: Far beyond every map of the stars, Elyra turns alone in the dark.
A world of six thousand four hundred kilometres in radius. No moon lights its nights.
Its gravity is gentle. Here, every stone weighs a little less, and every wave climbs a little higher.
A day lasts twenty-nine hours. A year, three hundred and seventy-seven days.
More than half of its face is water. Oceans seven kilometres deep, where no light has ever reached.
On the land, rivers carve their way through green valleys, toward the sea.
Further on, the deserts burn beneath a white sun.
At the edges of the world, the ice has never melted. And the mountains climb above nine thousand metres.
Forty-six volcanoes rise from its skin. Twenty-one of them still burn.
Its land is already divided into seventy-one realms. But no one has ever walked them.
